The Caffevolve™ Platform
Caffeine is one of the most universally embraced substances on Earth — woven into the daily rhythm of billions of lives worldwide for its unique ability to waken, sharpen focus, and energize the day. But that same special ability carries a steep cost when left unmanaged: overuse or untimely consumption overwhelms the very alertness it promises, quietly steals a peaceful night of rest, and turns a trusted ritual into a source of regret.
The Caffevolve™ Platform has been designed to make that trade-off unnecessary by placing intelligent, well-timed caffeine management in your hands — so you can enjoy the full benefit of caffeine without paying its all-too-common price.

The Intelligence Center This is what sets Caffevolve apart from anything else in the coffee appliance universe. The Intelligence Center sits at its very core — the brain behind Caffevolve's unequaled ability to consistently deliver a brew that carries the unique benefits of caffeine while avoiding its well-known pitfalls.

It does so by first developing a solid understanding of a few relevant personal details about you and your schedule.
Personal Caffeine Sensitivity The first personal element considered by the Caffevolve brain is your sensitivity to caffeine. Everyone is different.

Knowing how it affects you and shapes your day plays a big role in determining how Caffevolve is able to consistently brew a cup that's right for you.
Projected Bedtime Workdays, days off, special events — they all can impact when you decide to hit the pillow.

Understanding what you are planning for tonight is the second personal consideration taken into account in the Intelligence Center calculations.
Previous 24 Hr Consumption Caffeine doesn't just go away when the cup is finished — it lingers, often for hours. As the cups add up throughout the day, the caffeine level still active in your system can build — climbing well past what feels comfortable, without you ever noticing. Staying ahead of this is a primary goal of the Intelligence Center.

Understanding how much caffeine has already been consumed is the third personal consideration taken into account.
Current Time of Day As you know, the time of day when a brew is about to be prepared plays a big part in how it's likely to impact the rest of your day — or more notably, your night. This is the final consideration taken into account by the Intelligence Center.

What makes sense at 10 am looks nothing like what makes sense at 4 pm.
Recommended Caffeine Blend So how does the Platform Intelligence Center keep you balanced each day? By recommending a specific caffeine blend for every cup — from fully caffeinated to a caff/decaf mix to full decaf — adjusted to your unique sensitivity to caffeine and other key factors that matter at that moment.

This is the Caffevolve difference!

The Dilemma

Billions of people reach for it before they reach for anything else. There's a reason — but there's a limit.

The slumber that clears. The mind that arrives. For people across the globe, every single day, coffee creates the conditions for their best work and their most human moments.

But that lift follows a curve, not a straight line. As levels rise, performance improves — alertness sharpens, focus deepens. But the improvement isn't indefinite. Beyond a personal threshold, the gains reverse: agitation replaces calm, and long after the cup is finished, the same compound that sharpened the afternoon quietly steals the night — the racing mind that won't slow down, the sleep that won't come.

This isn't a fringe concern. It's the universal experience of anyone who has ever relied on coffee to get through their day.

Continue
Back to Home
The Reaction

So what do they do? They stop.

Not because the afternoon is finished. Not because the work is done. But because somewhere along the way they learned — through too much afternoon overstimulation, too many restless nights, and mornings feeling everything but refreshed — that another cup after a certain point is a gamble they just don't want to take. The fear of a sleepless night overrides the drive to finish the day on a strong note. So they put the cup down. And they get through the afternoon on whatever they have left.

What they're giving up in that moment is real. The meeting that needed one more hour of sharp thinking. The project that was almost there. The afternoon that could have finished strong instead of fading quietly into the end of the day.

Continue
Back to Home
The Opportunity

Not more caffeine each day. Just more of the day to enjoy it.

All coffee drinkers begin each day with a physiological caffeine threshold — a limit your body sets on how much caffeine it can comfortably handle before it starts working against you. That threshold becomes your daily allowance: a budget you draw from, cup by cup, until it runs out. Each cup of standard brew claims a slice of it, so you ration your cups to stay within reach: "Yes, I'll have another cup." Or, "No, I really shouldn't." Period.

But what if that same allowance could be drawn from with far more granularity — with more control and more precision? Instead of surrendering to a binary yes-or-no on every standard fully caffeinated cup, why couldn't there be a new path — one that stretches that same threshold across more hours of the day by adjusting the caffeine dose in every cup, not just the count of cups?

01
A lighter dose in each cup, allowing a few more to be enjoyed later in the day, right when you need them, without costing you a night's sleep?
02
A stronger dose early, when the day demands it most — dialed down as evening approaches?
03
Knowing exactly where you stand with caffeine at any given moment — so every cup is a well-thought-out decision, and you're in complete control of your day?

It's not more caffeine each day — it's the same amount managed more judiciously, serving its purpose later into the afternoon and evening, while still protecting the wind-down that leads to a good night's rest.

The Solution

The Caffevolve Path

The Caffevolve™ Intelligent Brewing Platform provides a fresh path to maximizing the focus, productivity, and socialization benefits of caffeine, while honoring the physiological caffeine threshold you've learned to respect.

The Platform opens this path with personalized caffeine guidance — a caffeine content recommendation delivered each time a brew is about to be prepared. That recommendation takes the form of a "bean blend": a calculated ratio of caffeinated to decaffeinated beans, dispensed, blended, ground, and brewed to deliver that specific caffeine content.

Continue
Back to Home
The Caffeine Recommendation

The Key Ingredients

The Caffevolve guidance is based on many factors, but the following have the most significant impact:

—
Personal sensitivity to caffeine
—
Projected bedtime for that day — confirmed at brew time
—
Caffeine consumption since the day began
—
The current time of the brew request

It's a complex calculation that results in a bean blend recommendation that provides the user with confidence that their caffeine intake is being managed effectively.

It's important to note, however, that although the blend guidance provided is regarded as the best path forward, the user is always free to manually adjust the bean blend as they desire with any brew.

Once the choice is made, it's as simple as pressing brew.

The Twin Bean Program

Any Bean Combination Works. Paired Bean Combinations Work Beautifully.

The Caffevolve™ Platform works with any bean type or roast level loaded into its hoppers. Once the user identifies the beans in use, the device compensates for any differences in type or roast within its blend calculations. However, the more closely related the caffeinated and decaffeinated beans are, the better the taste profile holds together as the blend shifts throughout the day.

The certification mark that will be carried by every bag that meets the Twin Bean Program specifications.

The planned Caffevolve™ Twin Bean Program, being developed in partnership with premium roasters, advances this bean alignment even further by:

—
Sourcing pairings from the same farm and harvest batch wherever possible
—
Processing the decaf bean using methods that preserve a matching flavor profile
—
Roasting both the caff and decaf beans to complement one another

It's how a fully caffeinated morning cup and a decaf-leaning evening cup can taste like the same coffee, regardless of caffeine content.

The Platform

One system. Three components. Each incomplete alone.

Platform Intelligence Center
The brain. Continuously tracks the caffeine currently active in your system and calculates a personalized caffeine recommendation for every cup.
Precision Brewing Device
The Platform home. Executes the personalized caffeine recommendation precisely and brews it in alignment with SCA standards to create a consistently delicious cup each time.
Away from Home Guidance
The mobile app that follows you out the door, so every cup you consider while away gets the same personalized guidance as one brewed at home.

Each component standing alone is incomplete.

A brewer with no intelligence is just a coffee maker. Intelligence with no device can recommend but can't act. And a device that only knows what happens at home is blind to every cup you have outside it. That blind spot can quietly corrupt the caffeine level the Platform recognizes as still active in your system — the very thing every Caffevolve recommendation depends on.

The Platform only works as an effective advisor because it's all three components, working together, all hours of the day.

Continue
Back to Home
CaffevolveGo

Your Caffeine Status. Wherever You Are.

The Intelligence Center and the Device work seamlessly to craft the perfect cup at home. But most caffeine isn't decided at home — it's decided in line, at a counter, in a break room. That's what the Platform's third piece is built for.

CaffevolveGo is the mobile app that carries the Platform with you, sharing the same Platform Intelligence Center that drives your brewing device.

At its center is the Offsite Advisory System (OAS) — the layer that steps in right when you're deciding what to drink, wherever you are.

Guidance at the Moment of Decision

OAS meets you at the decision itself — not after the fact, but in the moment you're actually choosing, wherever that happens: a break-room counter, a café line, a restaurant menu in front of you.

In each place, OAS lays out the full caffeine menu of what a venue like that typically offers, and highlights and ranks first the drinks that fit within your comfort zone. Nothing is hidden and nothing is filtered away; the complete list is always in front of you. The choices that work for you right now are simply the ones you see first, picking up right where you left off at home.

It opens on a dedicated Worksite view, because the workplace is the one place a caffeine management system usually goes blind — and, for many people, where a real share of the day's caffeine actually happens. But the guidance doesn't end at the office door. It follows you everywhere the next cup gets decided.

The Caffevolve™ Platform · With you every step of the way

One day. Every cup. One clear picture.

Each component standing alone is incomplete. Caffevolve only works as an effective advisor because it links together all three platform components to seamlessly capture the complete day. This is what that looks like across an ordinary day: the device handles the coffee a person brews at home, the Offsite Advisory System is there for everything they drink away from it, and wherever they are, they always know where their caffeine level stands. Follow Diane from her first cup to her last, and watch a full day of coffee still end in a good night’s sleep.

Diane has a low sensitivity to caffeine. It clears her system fairly quickly, and she tolerates it well throughout the day. Her personal Bedtime Ceiling is set at 75 mg — the most caffeine that can remain in her system at her 11:00 PM bedtime without possibly disturbing her sleep.

In a nutshell, this is what Diane's day looks like: four cups across the day — two at home, two away — and each one lands in the same picture.

7:00 AM · Home

The day starts where it always has

Diane is up early and brews her first cup at 7:00, at home, on her device — a 12 oz cup at Medium strength, which will add about 160 mg of caffeine into her system. Nothing new happens here — this is Diane’s go-to drink when she first wakes up.

The “Projected at bedtime” line below is simply telling Diane that if this is the only cup of coffee she has today, she will still have 16 mg of caffeine in her system when she heads for bed — but it’s well below the 75 mg ceiling she needs to stay below to protect her sleep.

Projected at bedtime16 mg / 75 mg ceiling
Home cup logged — the day’s picture starts here.
8:30 AM · Worksite

It’s there at the office, too

Just after 8:30, there’s a fresh pot in the break room — the one place a caffeine management system usually goes blind. Diane opens CaffevolveGo, taps the Worksite venue, and logs a full cup of office drip in a couple of taps, about 110 mg. It folds straight into the same picture her home device started, so the office stops being a hole in her day.

Projected at bedtime25 mg / 75 mg ceiling
Office coffee logged — nothing missing yet.

This second drink adds to the caffeine that accumulates in Diane’s system but is still well below the 75mg ceiling.

1:00 PM · Coffee Shop

A Menu That Knows Her Ceiling

After lunch out with the group, Diane stops at a coffee shop nearby. She opens CaffevolveGo, taps the venue, and a typical coffee shop menu pops up, listing likely drink options with an estimated caffeine content shown for each. The OAS makes it easy for Diane to choose wisely by highlighting the drink options that keep her below the Bedtime Ceiling that protects her sleep — but Diane is free to choose whatever she’d like.

She picks a small drip from the list and logs it in a couple of taps — about 110 mg — and it becomes part of the same running picture as everything else.

Projected at bedtime49 mg / 75 mg ceiling
Coffee shop logged — same picture, every time.
3:00 PM · Home

By late afternoon, nothing is a guess

A big presentation is due in the morning, so Diane heads straight home from the coffee shop to work undisturbed. At 3:00, she decides to brew one more cup to stay sharp until dinner. Because every earlier cup — the first one at home, the office pot, the coffee shop drip — is already accounted for in the picture, the device recognizes the need to pull back and recommends a caffeine blend of 50% caff/decaf: enough to keep her sharp for the next few hours, while landing her safely at 74 mg by her 11:00 PM bedtime — one mg under her 75 mg ceiling. A clear night’s sleep ahead of a morning that counts.

Projected at bedtime74 mg / 75 mg ceiling
Four cups in, one mg to spare — and a clear night ahead.

Four cups — two brewed at home, one from the office pot, one at the coffee shop — and every one lands in a single, running picture of Diane’s day. That is the point of the third piece of the Platform: an advisor that goes where she goes when she leaves the house, ensuring that informed decisions are always made and that whatever is consumed is accounted for by the Platform Intelligence Center — which is exactly what a device on the kitchen counter, however smart, could never see on its own.

The Future of Coffee
Humanity discovered coffee in the 9th century. For over a thousand years, one of the world's most practiced rituals has changed little — the good and the bad accepted as unmovable. Simply a universal, natural human reaction to one of Earth's prized plants.
But imagine a world where a cup of coffee never has to be a trade-off — where staying sharp into the late afternoon doesn't cost you the night's rest, where every cup serves its purpose instead of quietly working against you. That's the world Caffevolve is built for.
We do recognize that there's always risk in introducing a fresh approach to a very well-established, worldwide practice — but just imagine if...?

Three independent $75,000 post-money SAFE notes. No discount — cap only. Full terms, use-of-proceeds breakdown, and 18-month milestone projections are in the Seed One-Pager below.

Because this is a post-money SAFE, each investor's ~1.25% ownership is fixed at signing and protected from dilution by the other notes in this same round. An MFN provision ensures every investor receives the same terms as any better deal struck later in the round, and a Pro Rata right preserves that ownership percentage into the next priced financing.
